slides.quote: Don't mind us. We just work here.
slides.head: Meet the 4 villains hiding in your checkout.

slides.quote: They fill me up. Then they vanish. Every time.
slides.head: **7 in 10** online carts are abandoned before checkout.
slides.source: Baymard Institute, average of 50 studies, 70.22% (updated Sep 2025)
slides.scene: a cute translucent white ghost whose body is an empty orange shopping cart, floating away from a checkout counter and fading out, a few wrapped parcels left behind on the floor, spooky but cute

slides.quote: Oh, you thought *that* was the price?
slides.head: For shoppers ready to buy, the top reason they left: extra costs at checkout. Shipping, taxes, fees.
slides.source: Baymard checkout survey, US shoppers (excluding “just browsing”)
slides.scene: a sneaky grinning orange price-tag monster trailing a very long blank paper receipt, jumping out from behind a checkout counter and startling a shopper with a full cart, coins spilling

slides.quote: Before you buy, make a password. Twelve characters. One symbol. One small sacrifice.
slides.head: **Nearly 1 in 5** shoppers ready to buy have left a cart because the site made them create an account.
slides.source: Baymard, 18% of US shoppers who weren't just browsing

slides.quote: Take your time. I'll just keep spinning.
